snippet.title: Marathon Recompiled - Kingdom Valley Gameplay
snippet.description:
Marathon (Sonic '06) Recompiled Kingdom Valley running at 60 FPS with (mostly) fully working rendering, sound effects, and gameplay.

Although this looks pretty complete, we're a long way from release (and no ETA), so please be patient while we make this game the best it can be.

Recorded on an M4 Pro MacBook Pro running macOS Tahoe using OBS.
